name: Nextcloud Photo Frame
description: Photo screensaver from Nextcloud Files folders and personal Photos albums, with shuffle and a bounded in-memory offline cache.
author: kminhtri

settings.title: Nextcloud server URL
settings.description: Include any installation subpath, for example https://cloud.example.com/nextcloud.

settings.title: App password
settings.description: Create an app password in Nextcloud personal Security settings.

settings.title: Photo source
settings.description: Read Files folders, personal albums from the Nextcloud Photos app, or combine both in one slideshow.

settings.title: Photo folders
settings.description: Add folder paths relative to Nextcloud Files home, for example Photos/Family. Use / for Files home. Up to 32 folders and albums in total.

fields.title: Folder path
fields.description: Relative to Files home, for example Photos/Family. Use / for Files home.

settings.title: Photo folder
settings.description: Folder relative to your Nextcloud Files home. For a Photos album, change Photo source instead.

settings.title: Additional photo folders
settings.description: Add other folders from the same account. Photos from all selected folders form one slideshow; duplicates are skipped.

fields.title: Folder path
fields.description: Relative to your Nextcloud Files home, for example Holidays/2026.

settings.title: Photo albums
settings.description: Add exact personal album names from Nextcloud Photos. Public links and shared albums are not supported. Up to 32 folders and albums in total.

fields.title: Album name
fields.description: Exact album name, for example Holidays 2026. Do not paste a URL or folder path.

settings.title: Include subfolders
settings.description: Applies only to Files folders; albums are never traversed recursively. Up to 20 levels, 100 collections and 5000 unique photos per refresh, with loop detection.

settings.title: Seconds per photo
settings.description: The interval starts once a photo is ready.

settings.title: Shuffle
settings.description: Play a shuffled cycle without repeating until the cycle ends.

settings.title: Photo scaling
settings.description: Fit shows the whole photo; Fill crops it to cover the screen.

settings.title: Refresh sources every
settings.description: Minutes between folder and album membership refreshes.

settings.title: Photos to keep in memory
settings.description: Cached photos remain available during connection failures until the plugin stops.

settings.title: Allow unencrypted HTTP
settings.description: Use only on a trusted local network. HTTPS is recommended.

settings.title: Night mode
settings.description: Turn off the display after the room stays dark while this photo frame is visible, and wake it when daylight returns. Requires a light sensor and Kiosk Satellite screen-off permission.

settings.title: Night light threshold
settings.description: Enter night mode at or below this value. Exit and wake above 125% of it, matching the native Clock (5 lx wakes above 6.25 lx). Unavailable readings suspend the countdown.

settings.title: Turn screen off after
settings.description: Continuous minutes in night mode while this screensaver is shown. Waking the screen starts a fresh delay; normal Kiosk Satellite wake controls still apply.
